stem: The heights of buildings in a large city are normally distributed with mean 18.3 m and standard deviation 2.5 m.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Find the probability that the total height of 5 randomly chosen buildings in the city is more than 95 m.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Find the probability that the difference between the heights of two randomly chosen buildings in the city is less than 1 m.
